about_the_game:
SIGILLUM is a first-person survival horror videogame inspired by the history and culture of the city of Málaga.

The streets have fallen into darkness, the disease has spread, and souls wander aimlessly. You must uncover the secrets hidden behind the sudden appearance of this new threat, eliminating or avoiding the enemies that will appear along the way, seeking alternative routes and solving puzzles that will allow you to continue with the divine mission, with the objetive of ending the nightmare.

Features

Style Inspired by Classic Survival Horror

  • The classic gameplay and artistic style is combined with polished animations to deliver a dynamic experience to the player.

Faithful Representation of the City

  • Explore the streets of Málaga, a city with a mysterious and sinister background, rendered with great attention to detail.

Narrative Inspired by Reality

  • SIGILLUM's narrative incorporates elements from real events that occurred hundreds of years ago.

Tricked-out Camera

  • Use your camera's flash to detect enemies and render them vulnerable to your attacks.

What Hides in the Shadows

  • Enemies are virtually imperceptible in the dark, so you'll need to rely on ambient lighting and your camera to detect danger.

content_descriptors.notes: A first-person survival horror game that contains elements of violence and combat against hostile enemies. Players will use melee weapons such as daggers, hammers, and spears, as well as firearms, including pistols and shotguns, to defend themselves against the infected. Combat is primarily close-quarters, and enemies may release small amounts of blood when hit. The environment may feature scenes with corpses and visible bloodstains. When an enemy is defeated, their body will remain on the ground as part of the scene. Some in-game dialogue may include coarse language and mild profanity and Combat is a necessity for survival, not a glorification of harm. The religious theme is used as a narrative tool to enrich the context and atmosphere of the game. It is approached in a respectful and careful manner, with no intention to offend anyone, and is aligned with the cultural and historical setting of the city. The portrayal of religious elements is designed to be an integral part of the narrative, without promoting or criticizing any religious beliefs or practices.
